settings.heading: 13 years of teaching people to build
settings.story_text:
In 2012, James and Ian opened a small workshop in Hackney with one goal: prove that anyone can build a bicycle frame.

What started as a weekend experiment became a movement. Today, BBC frames have been ridden from London to New Zealand, across the Andes, and through monsoons in India.

Every bike we help create is someone's first — and usually their favourite.
settings.founder_quote: If we want people to choose sustainable options, we need to offer something better than what polluting products can be.

settings.label: Why Bamboo?
settings.heading: Nature's Perfect Frame Material
settings.text: Bamboo combines the best qualities of steel, carbon, and titanium. It's stronger than steel, absorbs vibration better than carbon fibre, and grows back in just 3-5 years.
Natural vibration dampening for comfortable rides
Each frame is unique — your bike, your build

settings.label: Social Impact
settings.heading: Building More Than Bikes
settings.text: From prison rehabilitation to school programmes, we use bamboo bicycle building to create real change. Our Build to Bond programme helps parents in prison build bikes for their children — maintaining family connections and learning skills for release.

settings.quote: Innovative projects like Build to Bond support rehabilitation and help people leave prison as better citizens.

settings.question: Do I need any experience?
settings.answer: No. 95% of our builders have never built anything like this before. Our guides and video tutorials make it accessible to complete beginners.

settings.question: How long does it take to build?
settings.answer: A workshop takes 2-3 days. Building from a kit at home typically takes 35-40 hours spread over several weekends.

settings.question: Is a bamboo bicycle strong enough?
settings.answer: Absolutely. Bamboo has a higher tensile strength than steel. Our frames are tested and rated for riders up to 120kg. One of our bikes has been ridden 8,288 miles through the Andes.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship kits to 36+ countries worldwide. International shipping typically costs £50-150 depending on destination.
